data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'sata', meaning 'to sit'. In Islamic tradition, the name Basita is a symbol of tranquility and peace. It is said that the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) named his granddaughter Basitah, meaning 'the resting one', as a sign of the peace and contentment she brought to his household. The name Basita carries the meaning “Sitting, resting” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Basita usually hope their child will grow to embody sitting, resting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
